newsitem.title: USA: U.S. protests Cuban search of diplomatic pouch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. protests Cuban search of diplomatic pouch.

text.p: The United States lodged a formal protest with Cuba after Cuban officials interfered with several diplomatic pouches destined for the U.S. interests section in Havana, the State Department said on Friday.
"It's a blatant violation of international diplomatic law," State Department spokesman Nicholas Burns told reporters.

"We protested formally and clearly and emphatically and the Cuban government interfered with our pouches," Burns said. "And the Cuban government has no authority to regulate the content of what's in our diplomatic pouches and what's not."

Burns said the distribution of several diplomatic pouches was delayed and one pouch was opened and inspected. He cited what he called the "extraordinary chutzpah (nerve) of the Cubans", saying that Cuban officials complained about the contents of one pouch.
"The Cuban government claimed that one of the pouches arrived opened, and it contained objectionable aggressive informational material," Burns said.
The United States does not have formal diplomatic relations with Cuba, but does have an interests section in Havana.
